items.text: Seahawks placing RB Jadarian Price on IR due to chest injury aggravated in practice; misses min 4 weeks.
items.implication: Longer absence, role to others like Wilson/Holani/Charbonnet

items.text: Puka Nacua listed IN for Week 4 after hip injury; expected to play vs Eagles, possible snap limits per speculation.
items.why: Cleared injury report, full or near practices
items.implication: WR1 upside returns but monitor snaps

items.text: Nico Collins listed IN returning from hamstring; excellent DvP vs Cowboys.
items.implication: Elite WR1 spot, Texans high implied total
Jordan Addison primary beneficiary home vs weak secondary

items.text: Devonta Smith OUT (hamstring) along with Goedert; Eagles missing key pieces vs Rams.
items.implication: Hurts downgrade, Wicks/others benefit; Eagles offense worse

items.text: Colts downgraded WR Keenan Allen to OUT (groin) vs Commanders; elevated Nick Westbrook-Ikhine.
Excellent spot for Nico Collins return; Cowboys inflate opposing WR scoring 7.3% most in NFL, Texans 7th-most implied points.
Jordan Addison truthers moment: home vs borderline NFL secondary with Jefferson out.
Eagles situation worse: without Smith, Goedert, Baun vs Rams.

Tough runout for Jadarian Price: lost GL/base to Wilson, pass to Holani, fumbles, hurt chest, Charbonnet back; still long-term upside.
items.conflict: eye test positive but usage negative
